cves.summary: IBM Langflow OSS 1.0.0 through 1.12.2 could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code due to an expected dependency confusion.
cves.headline: Langflow OSS 1.0.0 through 1.12.2 allows remote code execution via dependency confusion

name: Expected Behavior Violation
title: CWE-440: Expected Behavior Violation
ai_text: In AI software, CWE-440 shows up when a component quietly does something other than what its own specification promises. The one CVE here sits in Langflow, an open source framework for building LLM applications and agent flows, where versions 1.0.0 through 1.12.2 are affected. The gap is reached through dependency confusion, meaning the package resolution behavior does not match what the project says it should do, so a component the application trusts is not the one it expected. That mismatch lets an attacker run code remotely on the host running the Langflow instance. The failure is not a crash or a missing check, it is a promise the software breaks about how it resolves and loads its dependencies.
description: A feature, API, or function does not perform according to its specification.
